headline:
Walk-In Support Across
Gujarat & Uttar Pradesh
intro: Five Jal Agritech outlets and nurseries serve as full-service points for plants, irrigation parts, farm inputs and on-site advice.

outlets.name: Jal Agro Mall
outlets.description: Our flagship one-stop agri mall — irrigation systems, seeds, fertilizers, crop protection, farm machinery and expert guidance under one roof.

outlets.name: Neelkanth Nursery
outlets.description: Live plants, ornamentals, avenue trees, pots, planters and gardening tools for homes, businesses and institutions across Kutch.

outlets.name: Bholenath Nursery
outlets.description: Large-scale nursery supplying plantation drives, landscape projects and afforestation work across Gujarat and 10–15 neighbouring states.

outlets.name: Boondh Agritech
outlets.description: Sister concern for irrigation, landscaping and plantation — and a demonstration site for modern irrigation and horticulture practices.

outlets.name: Garden Care
outlets.description: Nursery and garden centre for live plants, decorative pots, planters and horticultural products across Uttar Pradesh.
